security_hardening_recommendations.finding: Internal ports (8090, 8080, 8642) are bound to 127.0.0.1 and not accessible from WAN. However, UFW firewall is currently INACTIVE.
security_hardening_recommendations.impact: If any future process binds to 0.0.0.0 accidentally, it will be immediately reachable from internet.
security_hardening_recommendations.action: Enable UFW firewall and explicitly allow only ports 22, 80, and 443.

security_hardening_recommendations.finding: BFF currently uses a shared current_user() = 'default'. All requests proxied through Nginx receive the internal X-Pegawai-AI-Key.
security_hardening_recommendations.impact: Currently in MVP prototype mode, all connected browser clients share the same default workspace and session context.
security_hardening_recommendations.action: For production multi-tenancy, implement per-user authentication (JWT / Session Cookie) and row-level tenant filtering (workspace_id/user_id) so users cannot access each other's chat history or knowledge base.

security_hardening_recommendations.finding: Nginx does not currently have limit_req_zone or limit_conn_zone configured.
security_hardening_recommendations.impact: A client sending high-frequency bursts could potentially exhaust server resources.
security_hardening_recommendations.action: Add rate limiting in /etc/nginx/nginx.conf (e.g., 20 requests/second with burst 30) for /bff/ and /api/ endpoints.

security_hardening_recommendations.finding: Missing X-Frame-Options (Clickjacking defense), X-Content-Type-Options (MIME sniffing defense), and Strict-Transport-Security (HSTS).
security_hardening_recommendations.impact: Vulnerabilities to iframe embedding or MIME-type confusion.
security_hardening_recommendations.action: Inject security headers in Nginx server block: add_header X-Frame-Options SAMEORIGIN; add_header X-Content-Type-Options nosniff; add_header Strict-Transport-Security 'max-age=31536000; includeSubDomains' always;
